name: Blue Zones Holdings Co Ltd
summary: Blue Zones Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the operation of supermarkets in Japan. The company offers various products, including fresh food, dried and processed food, and daily food, as well as delicatessen products. It also engages in the trading business and related operations; store-related services such as security, facility management, insurance agency; import and wholesale of food products, beverages, alcohol, and raw materials; and assisting with food manufacturing, processing, and packaging, and other related tasks. The company was formerly known as Yaoko Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Blue Zones Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2025. was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Kawagoe, Japan.
